xpack.link.hint: Your XPack account is not linked yet: pause menu → ⚙ → Link my account (or /xpack settings).
xpack.link.done: Account linked! Your achievements are now tracked.
xpack.link.revoked: Link revoked: link your account again from the pause menu → ⚙.
xpack.link.expired: Link code expired. To get a new one: pause menu → ⚙ → Link my account.
xpack.practice.auto: Creative world: this is a test world, XPack does not track it (nothing is sent, nothing is flagged).
xpack.practice.manual: This world is now a test world: XPack no longer tracks it. Your other worlds are not affected.
xpack.uuid_mismatch: This Minecraft account is not the one linked to XPack: nothing is sent.
xpack.flagged.creative: Creative mode detected: this world no longer counts on XPack.
xpack.flagged.spectator: Spectator mode detected: this world no longer counts on XPack.
xpack.flagged.godmode: Invulnerability detected: this world no longer counts on XPack.
xpack.warning.title: ⚠ This command counts as cheating
xpack.warning.body: If you continue, this world will no longer count on XPack (achievements, rankings, speedruns). Achievements already earned are kept.
xpack.cheatmode.title: ⚠ %s cheat mode is on
xpack.cheatmode.body.items: This mode lets you take any item from the list. If you keep it, this world will no longer count on XPack (achievements, rankings, speedruns). Achievements already earned are kept.
xpack.cheatmode.body.quests: Edit mode lets you complete quests and claim their rewards. If you keep it, this world will no longer count on XPack (achievements, rankings, speedruns). Achievements already earned are kept.
xpack.cheats_enabled: Cheats are enabled on this world. Your achievements still count as long as you don't use any cheat command.
xpack.flagged.blacklist: Cheat mod detected (%s): this world no longer counts on XPack.
xpack.consent.title: XPack Companion
xpack.consent.sent: Your advancements, the statistics needed for the modpack's achievements, the modpack name and version, cheat detections for this world, where the valuable items you receive come from (picked up, chest, quest…), the names of your resource packs and what you mine (ores, stone, tool).
xpack.consent.never: Chat, the names and UUIDs of other players (only a fingerprint, for /xpack check and your XPack team), the content of your worlds, your files and your game IP address.
xpack.consent.footer: You can change your mind anytime in the mod settings, and export or delete your data on xpack.saaoz.fr.
xpack.settings.title: XPack Companion settings
xpack.speedrun.started: Timer started. Free mode: unverified, not ranked.
xpack.speedrun.lost: Timer lost: you moved while paused. Restart it with the start key.
xpack.speedrun.title: Free speedrun
xpack.speedrun.import.doneBest: LiveSplit file read: %s steps and personal best.
xpack.speedrun.import.truncated: LiveSplit file read: %s steps, only the first %s are kept.
xpack.speedrun.import.error.too_big: File too big for a LiveSplit file.
xpack.speedrun.import.error.not_xml: This is not a readable LiveSplit file.
xpack.speedrun.import.error.not_lss: This is not a LiveSplit (.lss) file.
xpack.speedrun.import.error.no_segments: This LiveSplit file has no steps.
xpack.speedrun.export.done: Run exported (JSON, CSV, LiveSplit, text). The speedrun.com text is copied.
xpack.speedrun.export.notFinished: Nothing to export: finish the timer first.
xpack.command.speedrun: free speedrun timer: keys, steps, display
xpack.settings.server.inWorld: Leave the world to change server.
xpack.server.local_active: XPack: LOCAL server (development). Nothing is sent to the online website.
xpack.server.local_gone: Local XPack server unreachable (Docker stopped?): your achievements wait for it. XPack settings → Server to go back online.
xpack.settings.linked: %s is linked to an XPack account.
xpack.settings.unlinked: %s is not linked to XPack yet.
xpack.settings.practice: Test world: do not track this world
xpack.settings.practiceOn: This is a test world (not tracked)
xpack.settings.practiceConfirm: Nothing from this world will be sent to XPack anymore: its achievements won't count, but it won't be flagged either. This is permanent for this world; your other worlds don't change.
xpack.settings.privacy: Only your progress, tracked statistics and cheat detections are sent.
xpack.alert.title: ⚠ This world is no longer counted
xpack.alert.supportHover: Wrong detection? Tell us what happened.
xpack.support.title: Contact XPack support
xpack.support.sentTitle: Sent with your message (nothing else: no chat, no log, no files):
xpack.support.context: Modpack: %s · %s mods · game and mod versions
xpack.support.placeholder: Explain what you were doing (e.g. I was using the modpack's jetpack)…
xpack.support.sent: Sent! The answer will arrive at your XPack account email.
xpack.support.failed: Could not send right now. Try again in a few minutes.
xpack.support.needLink: Link your XPack account first: support will answer by email.
xpack.command.help.title: XPack commands:
xpack.command.click: Click to write it in the chat
xpack.command.settings: settings: link or unlink your account, test world
xpack.command.diagnostic: what the mod detects about your modpack (folder to send for tests)
xpack.command.toast: show a test toast (the modpack's first achievement)
xpack.diagnostic.done: Diagnostic ready. Detected modpack: %s. Files found: %s.
xpack.started_late: This world was started without XPack: it doesn't count, even from now on. Create a new world to collect your achievements.
xpack.difficulty_warning.title: Difficulty lowered
xpack.difficulty_warning.body: The difficulty went from %s to %s. A few minutes change nothing, but if this world stays lower for more than 10 minutes, its difficulty badge drops and its achievements give fewer points. Raising it again later won't bring the badge back up.
xpack.difficulty_warning.server: The server went from %s to %s. If it stays lower for more than 10 minutes, this world's difficulty badge drops and its achievements give fewer points.
xpack.command.check: Which online players have the XPack mod
xpack.command.team: your XPack team: invite players on the server, answer an invite
xpack.team.reminder: Teams from other mods (FTB Teams…) don't count for XPack. For your team achievements, create your XPack team.
xpack.team.suggest: Other players have the XPack mod here. Without an XPack team, your achievements count as solo: invite your teammates.
xpack.team.invited: %s invites you to their XPack team.
xpack.team.title: XPack team
xpack.team.none: No team yet for this modpack: your achievements count as solo. Invite a player below.
xpack.team.hintInstall: install XPack to join the team
xpack.team.leaveConfirm: Your next achievements will count as solo. The ones you already earned as a team stay yours.
xpack.team.footer: A teammate only counts when they play with you, here and at the same time.
xpack.team.unlinked: Link your XPack account to play as a team.
xpack.team.unavailable: Join a server with XPack tracking on to form a team.
xpack.team.error.not_on_server: This player isn't detected on the server anymore. Try again in a minute.
xpack.team.error.already_teammate: This player is already in your team.
xpack.team.error.too_many_invites: Too many pending invites. Wait for answers.
xpack.team.error.invite_expired: This invite isn't valid anymore: the player who sent it left the team.
xpack.team.error.offline: Can't reach XPack right now. Try again in a moment.
xpack.check.title: Your account is linked to XPack. XPack mod for the other players:
xpack.check.title_unlinked: XPack mod for the other players (your account isn't linked yet: /xpack settings):
xpack.check.hint: To be part of your XPack team (/xpack team), a player needs the mod installed and linked. Get the mod: xpack.saaoz.fr/mod
xpack.check.alone: No other player online. Your account is linked to XPack.
xpack.check.alone_unlinked: No other player online. Your account isn't linked yet: /xpack settings.
xpack.check.no_world: Join a world or a server to check the other players.
